title: Geoid Height
text: Calculate undulations/height, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Geopotential model} sets Geopotential model; {Units} sets the parameter and output units Metric, {Geopotential mat-file} sets the geopotential, {Data type} and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range input behavior. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Parameter and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of input and output signals double (default) | single

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range input behavior Warning (default) | Error | None
